title: Content in two scopes with differing policies takes the most restrictive value of each parameter
rationale: The parameters are combined independently, not by choosing whichever single policy looks stricter overall. Health (conservative) supplies the lowest frequency and the highest threshold; technology (explorer) supplies neither. An engine that picks one policy wholesale gets the frequency right by luck and the exploratory permission wrong.

requirement.text: When content falls into multiple scopes whose policies differ, or classification is too uncertain to be stated honestly, the engine MUST apply the most restrictive combination parameter-wise: the lowest applicable proposalFrequency, the highest applicable evidenceThreshold, and the lowest applicable autoAcceptCeiling (none < trivial < minor).
